items.mainDefect: getClientsWithPermission takes every resource returned by findByType(server, 'Clients'), including the all-clients resource named 'Clients', so a bogus 'Clients' entry ends up in the set of granted client ids.

secondary.defect: Per-client resources are stored under a different resource type than the 'Clients' key used in findByType, so the lookup can miss them and return a wrong or empty set of client ids.
